import json, random, struct, sys, time
import kit

# ---------- state preparation at scale ------------------------------------
def state_scale(states=1024, transitions=16384, runs=256, unreachable=False):
    names = ["S%d" % i for i in range(states)]
    types = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": names},
             {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 1},
             {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"]],
                "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
    random.seed(7)
    seen = set()
    items = []
    while len(items) < transitions:
        frm = random.randrange(states)
        to = random.randrange(states)
        command = "c%d" % len(items)
        if (frm, command) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add((frm, command))
        guard = ["eq", ["var", "msg"], ["const", "M", "k%d" % (len(items) % 64)]]
        items.append({"from": names[frm], "to": names[to], "command": command,
                      "cost": random.randrange(1, 65535), "when": guard})
    machine = {"states": names, "initial": names[0], "state_param": "st",
               "message_param": "msg", "transitions": items}
    target = names[states - 1] if not unreachable else "S0"
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    index = names.index(target)
    payloads = []
    for i in range(runs):
        payloads.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
            [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
             zip(plan["slots"], [index, ord("a") + (i % 64)])] +
            [("r", b"\x00")])})
    campaign["runs"] = payloads
    return campaign


for label, kwargs in (("reachable", dict()),
                      ("unreachable target", dict(states=4096, runs=64))):
    campaign = state_scale(**kwargs)
    out, seconds = None, None
    start = time.time()
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    print("state %-20s %6.2fs records=%s statuses=%s" % (
        label, time.time() - start, len(out["records"]),
        {r["status"] for r in out["records"]}))
    if label == "reachable":
        assert all(r["status"] == "READY" for r in out["records"]), out["records"][:4]

# ---------- expression evaluation at scale --------------------------------
def expr_scale(nodes_per_run=2048, runs=2000):
    types = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}, {"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
             {"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4}]
    # a right-nested chain of `and` over constant comparisons
    predicate = ["eq", ["const", "I", 1], ["const", "I", 1]]
    body = predicate
    for _ in range(nodes_per_run // 3):
        body = ["and", predicate, body]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["p", "I"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": body}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [("x0", b"\x01"), ("x1", b"\x00")])} for _ in range(runs)]
    return campaign


campaign = expr_scale()
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("expressions %6.2fs" % (time.time() - start), out["records"][0], len(out["corpus"]))

# ---------- match heavy ----------------------------------------------------
def match_scale(runs=1500, pattern="[a-c][0-9]*(x|y|z)*", maxsize=512):
    types = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
             {"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": maxsize}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": ["match", ["var", "s"], pattern]}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    payloads = []
    for i in range(runs):
        chars = [(97 + (i + j) % 3) if j % 7 else 48 + j % 10 for j in range(maxsize)]
        chars[i % maxsize] = 0            # truncate somewhere
        objs = [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], chars)]
        objs.append(("r", b"\x00"))
        payloads.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs)})
    campaign["runs"] = payloads
    return campaign


campaign = match_scale()
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("match %6.2fs" % (time.time() - start), {r["status"] for r in out["records"]},
      len(out["corpus"]))
PYEOF
